comment: Chapter 2, Wau Bulan (GDD missions 2.1–2.4), Sawah Emas. Bayu calls his grandfather Atuk. BM is the source; EN is a natural translation. Lines await Izaf's native-speaker read (CULTURE §4).

k2.bayu.arrive.speaker: bayu
k2.bayu.arrive.bm: Sawah Emas. Tiap-tiap tahun Atuk bawa aku datang pesta wau ni.
k2.bayu.arrive.en: Sawah Emas. Every year Atuk brought me to this kite festival.

k2.bayu.festival.speaker: bayu
k2.bayu.festival.bm: Atuk selalu cakap, wau yang baik terbang sebab angin percayakan dia.
k2.bayu.festival.en: Atuk always said a good wau flies because the wind trusts it.
